awards.title: Wentworth's Computer Science Society
awards.subtitle: Treasurer
awards.description: Elected Treasurer for Wentworth's first Computer Science organization that is a Chapter of ACM. Wentworth's Computer Science Society was later awarded Organization of the Year in 2017.

awards.title: HackWITUs 1
awards.subtitle: Head of Finance
awards.description: https://hackwit.us/ - Helped raise more than $10,000 in sponsorships from companies such as GoPuff, Webster Bank, HealthcareSource, and Automation. Managed event's cash flow and maintained transparency with team using Excel.

awards.title: LeaderShape
awards.subtitle: Sponsored by Wentworth
awards.description: https://www.leadershape.org/ - Attended 4 day retreat where students from all around America learned how to become impactful leaders in their communities and be inclusive of their team members.

awards.title: Wentworth's Student Government
awards.subtitle: Treasurer
awards.description: First female elected Treasurer in 7+ years. Directed co-sponsorship program and managed annual $8500 budget

awards.title: Node.js Interactive 2017
awards.subtitle: Sponsored by Wentworth
awards.description: Sponsored by Wentworth to attend Node.js Interactive conference 2017 in Vancouver, Canada. Networked with developers in industry, learned how various companies utilize Javascript frameworks, and attended live workshops

awards.title: HackWITUs 2
awards.subtitle: Head of Finance
awards.description: Served as Head of Finance again for Wentworth's second annual hackathon. Helped raise more than $10,000 in sponsorships from companies such as Microsoft and Webster Bank.

awards.title: CIO Search Committee
awards.subtitle: Student Representative
awards.description: Recommended by Dean of Students to serve as Student Representative. Interviewed 9 candidates and helped narrow down to 1

awards.title: SheHacks Boston
awards.subtitle: Winner of Most Innovative Project and She</Learns> Challenge
awards.description: Competed against 100+ teams. Lead group of 5 novice programmers to build mobile app that allows victims of sexual/domestic violence to report evidence discreetly from abusers using Android Studio and Firebase.

awards.title: Community Standards Board
awards.subtitle: Council Member
awards.description: Passed interview and leadership elimination round to become one of Wentworth's Community Standards Board member. Purpose of board is to discuss ways to enforce school's code of conduct.

awards.title: HackWITUs 3
awards.subtitle: Head of Sponsorship
awards.description: New position to solely focus on sponsorship management (inspired by TechTogether team format). Helped raise more than $15,000 in sponsorships from companies such as Google and Microsoft.

awards.title: Information Security Council
awards.subtitle: Student Representative
awards.description: Recommended by Wentworth's Director of Student Engagement to join the school's Information Security Council. Brainstormed with CIO and various faculty members on how to increase campus data security

awards.title: TechTogether Boston 2019
awards.subtitle: Winner of IBM's Best Use of AI Challenge
awards.description: Competed against 100+ teams. Created prototype of an IOT facial recognition app that identified people based on an unbiased dataset using TensorFlow, Raspberry Pi, NodeRed, and OpenCV (Javascript and Python).

awards.title: Wentworth's Dean's List
awards.subtitle: Dean's List Recipient
awards.description: Placed on Dean's List at the end of every semester enrolled in school. Requirement is a minimum of a 3.50 GPA.

bio: Hi! Thank you for visiting my website!
I received my Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science with a minor in Applied Math from Wentworth Institute of Technology.
I've learned how to build projects from attending hackathons, tech workshops, undergrad work, and from teaching myself via online resources.

faq.question: What did you want to be when you grew up?
faq.answer: The short answer is to be happy. The long answer is finding out what makes me happy. At the moment, I think I do want to be some form of entrepreneur-ship in the next 5-10 years.
